title: AI订单93亿：销售预测75亿，差额去哪了？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Cisco reported 4-quarter earnings disappointing investors after the company projected it would make $7.5 billion for sales tied to the AI data set of boom.
segments.zh: 思科公布第四季度财报，令市场参与者失望，因其预计AI数据中心相关销售额为75亿美元。

segments.en: A number investors deemed conservative compared to prior figures like $9.3 billion over the past year. Bloomberg Intelligence's Wujin Ho joins us now.
segments.zh: 许多市场参与者认为这一数字过于保守，而此前一年该数字为93亿美元。彭博智库的吴金和现在加入我们。

segments.en: The problem is reconciling a backlog with forecasted AI revenue and how much of overall revenue is AI revenue. Where did your math now?
segments.zh: 问题在于如何协调积压订单与AI收入预测，以及AI收入占总收入的比例。你的计算如何？

segments.en: Yeah so thanks for having me on look I think the AI revenue of $7.5 billion was quite fine.
segments.zh: 是的，感谢邀请。我认为75亿美元的AI收入相当不错。

segments.en: You know they already guided to $6 billion in the last quarter results for fiscal 2027.
segments.zh: 他们在上一季度财报中已经给出了2027财年60亿美元的指引。

segments.en: You know I think that hang up with investors quite frankly Ed is more of the gross margin side than anything else. They did 66% gross margins in the fourth quarter guided to 66% in the
segments.zh: 坦白说，市场参与者更关注毛利率。第四季度毛利率为66%，第一季度指引也是66%。

segments.en: first quarter but it seems like there's going to be like a hundred to 150 point bases drop off and gross margins in quarters two to three. So the earnings power isn't as strong as people at
segments.zh: 但第二至第三季度毛利率似乎将下降100至150个基点，因此全年盈利动力不如预期。

segments.en: hope for the full year. Right. The $9.3 billion figure I referenced was the orders for AI-related gear that it's amassed over the last year and so they're saying okay you've told us here's a backlog
segments.zh: 对。我提到的93亿美元是过去一年AI相关设备的订单，他们告诉你这是积压订单，那么收入转化率如何？

segments.en: and here's how much revenue is it a conversion rate is to you? Yeah there is some conversion rate look the timing of the conversion rate is a little bit unclear as well which which may hold back
segments.zh: 是的，转化率的时间点尚不明确，这可能会拖累部分收入，其中一些销售将计入2028财年。
